en.bdb: The conduct of the house holder Sikh

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਵਨ ਚੰਦਨ ਆਖੀਐ ਬਹਲੇ ਬਿਸੀਅਰੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਪਟਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: baavan cha(n)dhan aakheeaai bahale biseear tis lapaTaahee|

en.bdb: The snakes are said to be coiled around the sandal tree (but the tree is not influenced by their poison).

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਥਰਾ ਪਥਰ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: paaras a(n)dhar patharaa pathar paaras hoi na jaahee|

en.bdb: The philosopher's stone exists among stones but does not turn out to be an ordinary stone.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਣੀ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਸਪਾਂ ਸਿਰੀਂ ਓਇ ਭਿ ਸਪਾਂ ਵਿਚਿ ਫਿਰਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: manee jinhaa(n) sapaa(n) siree(n) oi bh sapaa(n) vich firaahee|

en.bdb: The jewel-holding snake also roams about among the ordinary snakes.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਹਰੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੰਸੁਲੇ ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਤੀ ਚੁਗਿ ਚੁਗਿ ਖਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: laharee a(n)dhar ha(n)sule maanak motee chug chug khaahee|

en.bdb: From the waves of the pond, the swans pick up only pearls and gems to eat.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉਂ ਜਲ ਕਵਲ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਹੈ ਘਰਿਬਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਿ ਤਿਵਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: jiau(n) jal kaval alipat hai gharibaaree gursikh tivaahee|

en.bdb: As the lotus remains unsmeared in water, the same is the position of the householder Sikh.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜੀਵਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: aasaa vich niraas hoi jeevan mukat jugat jeevaahee|

en.bdb: He residing among all the hopes and cravings around, adopts the skill of liberation in life and lives (happily).
How could one eulogize the holy congregation.
